publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
intro: Can you become the king of card trading?
description:
Step into the chaotic world of card trading, where hype and luck rule everything. Run your own shop, buy low, sell high, and hunt for rare collectibles. Deal with unpredictable customers and wild market swings as you try to stay ahead. Upgrade your store, expand your stock, and chase every profitable opportunity. Only sharp instincts and quick decisions will keep your business growing.

Key Features
• Fast-moving market with sudden price spikes and crashes
• Buy, sell, and trade a wide range of collectible cards
• Haggle with quirky customers and unpredictable buyers
• Find rare cards in flea markets, drops, and secret trades
• Upgrade your shop to attract bigger crowds
• High-risk, high-reward decisions that shape your empire

Do you have what it takes?
